source: Mars 2020 Science Team photogeologic map, Table 2
coordinateNote: Representative unit locations only; points do not define unit boundaries. Interpretations are hypotheses in the source map.

features.name: Crater floor · fractured 1
features.description: Light-toned fractured and blocky bedrock below about −2,530 m. Origin remains uncertain.

features.name: Crater floor · fractured 2
features.description: Light-toned rough fractured bedrock mapped between about −2,530 and −2,440 m.

features.name: Crater floor · fractured rough
features.description: Rough, boulder-producing, crater-retaining unit; volcanic or sedimentary interpretations remain open.

features.name: Inner margin · fractured
features.description: Fractured margin bedrock; carbonate-bearing interpretations have been proposed, but the unit origin is unresolved.

features.name: Western fan · blocky
features.description: Blocky ridges and mesas interpreted as inverted coarse-grained fluvial channels.

features.name: Western fan · thinly layered
features.description: Thin alternating layers; interpreted as fine-grained prodelta or distal lacustrine deposits.

features.name: Western fan · thickly layered
features.description: Resistant, light-toned layers; possible delta-lobe or floodplain deposits.

features.name: Western fan · truncated layers
features.description: Curving truncated layers; possible point bars or subaqueous channel-levee complexes.

features.name: Northern fan · layered rough
features.description: Parallel, meter-scale layered fan deposits interpreted as distal deltaic material.

features.name: Crater rim · blocky
features.description: Resistant high-standing ridges that weather into blocks; impact basement interpretation.

features.name: Crater rim · breccia
features.description: Disrupted bedrock exposed on the Nili Planum-facing rim slope.

features.name: Crater rim · layered
features.description: Layered and fractured rim unit; interpreted as pre-impact basement.

features.name: Crater rim · rough
features.description: Rough, crater-retaining and fractured capping unit; origin uncertain.

features.name: Neretva Vallis · layered
features.description: Layered outcrops in the valley; interpreted as fluvial deposits or exposed channel bedrock.

features.name: Nili Planum · fractured
features.description: Light-toned fractured outcrop outside the crater rim; interpreted origin remains uncertain.
